options.name: client_id
options.description: The OAuth consumer key. If not set the environment variable E(BITBUCKET_CLIENT_ID) is used.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The OAuth consumer secret. If not set the environment variable E(BITBUCKET_CLIENT_SECRET) is used.

options.name: name
options.description: The FQDN of the known host.

options.name: password
options.description: The App password. If not set the environment variable E(BITBUCKET_PASSWORD) is used.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates desired state of the record.

options.name: user
options.description: The username. If not set the environment variable E(BITBUCKET_USERNAME) is used. O(ignore:username) is an alias of O(user) since community.general 6.0.0. It was an alias of O(workspace) before.

options.name: workspace
options.description: The repository owner. B(Note:) O(ignore:username) used to be an alias of this option. Since community.general 6.0.0 it is an alias of O(user).
